dhpak1.9:2.1: Asāre sāramatinoti imaṃ dhammadesanaṃ satthā veḷuvane
dhpak1.9:4.2: kappasatasahassādhikānaṃ catunnaṃ asaṅkhyeyyānaṃ matthake amaravatiyā nāma
dhpak1.9:4.3: nagare sumedho nāma brāhmaṇakumāro hutvā sabbasippesu nipphattiṃ patvā mātāpitūnaṃ accayena anekakoṭisaṅkhyaṃ dhanaṃ
dhpak1.9:4.4: pariccajitvā isipabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā himavante vasantojhānābhiññā nibbattetvā
dhpak1.9:5.3: sayampi ekaṃ padesaṃ gahetvā maggaṃ sodheti. Tasmiṃ
dhpak1.9:5.4: asodhiteyeva āgatassa satthuno attānaṃ setuṃ katvā kalale ajinacammaṃ
dhpak1.9:6.1: Satthārā taṃ disvāva “ buddhaṅkuro esa, anāgate kappasatasahassādhikānaṃ catunnaṃ asaṅkhyeyyānaṃ pariyosāne gotamo nāma
dhpak1.9:6.2: buddho bhavissatī ” ti byākato. Tassa satthuno aparabhāge
dhpak1.9:6.3: “ koṇḍañño maṅgalo sumano revato sobhito anomadassī padumo nārado
dhpak1.9:6.4: padumuttaro sumedho sujāto piyadassī atthadassī dhammadassī siddhattho tisso phusso vipassī sikhī vessabhū kakusandho
dhpak1.9:6.5: koṇāgamano kassapo ” ti lokaṃ obhāsetvā uppannānaṃ imesampi tevīsatiyā buddhānaṃ santike laddhabyākaraṇo,“
dhpak1.9:7.1: dasa pāramiyo, dasa upapāramiyo, dasa paramatthapāramiyo
dhpak1.9:7.2: ” ti samattiṃsa pāramiyo pūretvā vessantarattabhāve ṭhito
dhpak1.9:7.4: āyupariyosāne tusitapure nibbattitvā tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā
dhpak1.9:8.1: “ Kālo deva mahāvīra, uppajja mātukucchiyaṃ; Sadevakaṃ tārayanto, bujjhassu amataṃ padan ” ti.(bu. vaṃ.1.67)–
dhpak1.9:9.1: Vutte – “ Kālaṃ desañca dīpañca, kulaṃ mātarameva ca; Ime pañca viloketvā, uppajjati mahāyaso ” ti.
dhpak1.9:9.2: – Pañca mahāvilokanāni viloketvā tato cuto sakyarājakule paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā dasamāsaccayena mātukucchito vijāyi.
dhpak1.9:10.2: bhadrayobbanaṃ patvā tiṇṇaṃ utūnaṃ anucchavikesu tīsu
dhpak1.9:11.1: catutthavāre pabbajitaṃ disvā,“ sādhu pabbajjā ” ti
dhpak1.9:11.2: pabbajjāya ruciṃ uppādetvā uyyānaṃ gantvā tattha divasaṃ khepetvā
dhpak1.9:11.5: jātasāsanaṃ sutvā puttasinehassa balavabhāvaṃ ñatvā,“ yāva idaṃ bandhanaṃ na vaḍḍhati, tāvadeva naṃ chindissāmī ” ti
dhpak1.9:12.1: “ Nibbutā nūna sā mātā, nibbuto nūna so pitā; Nibbutā nūna sā nārī, yassāyaṃ īdiso patī ” ti.
dhpak1.9:13.1: Kisāgotamiyā nāma pitucchādhītāya bhāsitaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ sutvā,“
dhpak1.9:13.2: ahaṃ imāya nibbutapadaṃ sāvito ” ti muttāhāraṃ omuñcitvā
dhpak1.9:13.3: tassā pesetvā attano bhavanaṃ pavisitvā sirisayane nisinno niddopagatānaṃ nāṭakitthīnaṃ vippakāraṃ disvā
dhpak1.9:15.2: taṃ paṭikkhipitvā sabbaññutaṃ patvā attano vijitaṃ
dhpak1.9:15.4: upasaṅkamitvā tesaṃ santike adhigatavisesaṃ analaṅkaritvā chabbassāni
dhpak1.9:16.1: visākhapuṇṇamadivase pātova sujātāya dinnapāyasaṃ paribhuñjitvā nerañjarāya nadiyā suvaṇṇapātiṃ pavāhetvā nerañjarāya
dhpak1.9:16.2: nadiyā tīre mahāvanasaṇḍe nānāsamāpattīhi divasabhāgaṃ vītināmetvā
dhpak1.9:16.3: sāyanhasamaye sottiyena dinnaṃ tiṇaṃ gahetvā kāḷena
dhpak1.9:16.4: nāgarājena abhitthutaguṇo bodhimaṇḍaṃ āruyha tiṇāni santharitvā “
dhpak1.9:16.5: na tāvimaṃ pallaṅkaṃ bhindissāmi, yāva me anupādāya
dhpak1.9:16.6: āsavehi cittaṃ na muccissatī ” ti paṭiññaṃ katvā
dhpak1.9:18.1: sattasattāhaṃ bodhimaṇḍe vītināmetvā aṭṭhame sattāhe ajapālanigrodhamūle nisinno dhammagambhīratāpaccavekkhaṇena appossukkataṃ
dhpak1.9:19.3: ajjhesanaṃ adhivāsetvā,“ kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyan ” ti olokento āḷārudakānaṃ kālakatabhāvaṃ ñatvā
dhpak1.9:19.5: kāsipuraṃ gacchanto antarāmagge upakena saddhiṃ mantetvā
dhpak1.9:21.1: pavattitavaradhammacakko pañcamiyaṃ pakkhassa sabbepi te bhikkhū arahatte patiṭṭhāpetvā taṃ divasameva yasakulaputtassa
dhpak1.9:21.2: upanissayasampattiṃ disvā taṃ rattibhāge nibbinditvā gehaṃ pahāya
dhpak1.9:21.3: nikkhantaṃ disvā,“ ehi yasā ” ti pakkositvā tasmiṃyeva
dhpak1.9:21.4: rattibhāge sotāpattiphalaṃ pāpetvā punadivase arahattaṃ pāpetvā
dhpak1.9:21.5: aparepi tassa sahāyake catupaṇṇāsa jane ehibhikkhupabbajjāya
dhpak1.9:22.1: Evaṃ loke ekasaṭṭhiyā arahantesu jātesu vuṭṭhavasso pavāretvā,“ caratha, bhikkhave, cārikan ” ti saṭṭhi bhikkhū disāsu
dhpak1.9:23.2: tiṃsa jane bhaddavaggiyakumāre vinesi. Tesu sabbapacchimako
dhpak1.9:23.3: sotāpanno sabbuttamo anāgāmī ahosi. Te sabbepi ehibhikkhubhāveneva pabbājetvā disāsu pesetvā
dhpak1.9:24.3: vinetvā ehibhikkhubhāveneva pabbājetvā gayāsīse nisīdāpetvā ādittapariyāyadesanāya (mahāva.54; saṃ.
dhpak1.9:24.4: ni.4.28) arahatte patiṭṭhāpetvā tena arahantasahassena parivuto
dhpak1.9:25.2: dvādasanahutehi brāhmaṇagahapatikehi saddhiṃ āgatassa rañño madhuradhammakathaṃ kathento
dhpak1.9:25.3: rājānaṃ ekādasahi nahutehi saddhiṃ sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhāpetvā ekanahutaṃ saraṇesu patiṭṭhāpetvā
dhpak1.9:26.3: veḷuvanārāmaṃ paṭiggahetvā tattheva vāsaṃ kappesi. Tattha naṃ sāriputtamoggallānā upasaṅkamiṃsu.
dhpak1.9:28.1: Tatrāyaṃ anupubbikathā – anuppanneyeva hi buddhe rājagahato avidūre upatissagāmo kolitagāmoti dve brāhmaṇagāmā ahesuṃ.
dhpak1.9:28.2: Tesu upatissagāme sāriyā nāma brāhmaṇiyā gabbhassa
dhpak1.9:28.3: patiṭṭhitadivaseyeva kolitagāme moggaliyā nāma brāhmaṇiyāpi gabbho patiṭṭhāsi.
dhpak1.9:28.4: Tāni kira dvepi kulāni yāva sattamā kulaparivaṭṭā
dhpak1.9:28.5: ābaddhapaṭibaddhasahāyakāneva ahesuṃ, tāsaṃ dvinnampi ekadivasameva gabbhaparihāraṃ adaṃsu.
dhpak1.9:29.3: itarassa kolitagāme jeṭṭhakulassa puttattā kolitoti nāmaṃ
dhpak1.9:29.4: kariṃsu. Te ubhopi vuḍḍhimanvāya sabbasippānaṃ pāraṃ agamaṃsu.
dhpak1.9:29.5: Upatissamāṇavassa kīḷanatthāya nadiṃ vā uyyānaṃ vā gamanakāle pañca suvaṇṇasivikasatāni parivārāni honti,
dhpak1.9:29.6: kolitamāṇavassa pañca ājaññayuttarathasatāni. Dvepi janā pañcapañcamāṇavakasataparivārā honti.
dhpak1.9:30.1: Rājagahe ca anusaṃvaccharaṃ giraggasamajjo nāma ahosi. Tesaṃ dvinnampi ekaṭṭhāneyeva mañcaṃ bandhanti.
dhpak1.9:30.2: Dvepi ekato nisīditvā samajjaṃ passantā hasitabbaṭṭhāne hasanti,
dhpak1.9:30.3: saṃvegaṭṭhāne saṃvejenti, dāyaṃ dātuṃ yuttaṭṭhāne dāyaṃ denti.
dhpak1.9:30.4: Tesaṃ imināva niyāmena ekadivasaṃ samajjaṃ passantānaṃ
dhpak1.9:30.5: paripākagatattā ñāṇassa purimadivasesu viya hasitabbaṭṭhāne hāso
dhpak1.9:30.6: vā saṃvegaṭṭhāne saṃvego vā dātuṃ yuttaṭṭhāne dānaṃ vā nāhosi.
dhpak1.9:31.2: kimettha oloketabbaṃ atthi, sabbepime appatte vassasate appaṇṇattikabhāvaṃ gamissanti,
dhpak1.9:31.3: amhehi pana ekaṃ mokkhadhammaṃ pariyesituṃ vaṭṭatī ” ti ārammaṇaṃ gahetvā nisīdiṃsu. Tato kolito upatissaṃ āha –
dhpak1.9:31.4: “ samma upatissa, na tvaṃ aññesu divasesu viya haṭṭhapahaṭṭho, idāni anattamanadhātukosi, kiṃ te sallakkhitan ” ti?
dhpak1.9:31.5: “ Samma kolita, etesaṃ volokane sāro natthi, niratthakametaṃ,
dhpak1.9:31.6: attano mokkhadhammaṃ gavesituṃ vaṭṭatī ” ti idaṃ cintayanto nisinnomhi.
dhpak1.9:31.7: Tvaṃ pana kasmā anattamanosīti? Sopi tatheva āha. Athassa attanā saddhiṃ ekajjhāsayataṃ ñatvā upatisso āha –
dhpak1.9:31.8: “ amhākaṃ ubhinnampi sucintikaṃ, mokkhadhammaṃ pana gavesantehi ekā
dhpak1.9:31.9: pabbajjā laddhuṃ vaṭṭati. Kassa santike pabbajāmā ” ti?
dhpak1.9:32.1: Tena kho pana samayena sañcayo nāma paribbājako rājagahe paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ.
dhpak1.9:32.2: Te “ tassa santike pabbajissāmā ” ti pañcamāṇavakasatāni “ sivikāyo ca rathe ca gahetvā gacchathā ” ti uyyojetvā ekāya
dhpak1.9:32.3: sivikāya ekena rathena gantvā sañcayassa santike pabbajiṃsu. Tesaṃ pabbajitakālato paṭṭhāya sañcayo atirekalābhaggayasaggappatto ahosi.
dhpak1.9:32.4: Te katipāheneva sabbaṃ sañcayassa samayaṃ parimadditvā,“ ācariya, tumhākaṃ
dhpak1.9:32.5: jānanasamayo ettakova, udāhu uttarimpi atthī ” ti pucchiṃsu.
dhpak1.9:32.6: “ Ettakova sabbaṃ tumhehi ñātan ” ti vutte cintayiṃsu –
dhpak1.9:33.1: “ evaṃ sati imassa santike brahmacariyavāso niratthako,
dhpak1.9:33.2: mayaṃ yaṃ mokkhadhammaṃ gavesituṃ nikkhantā, so imassa santike
dhpak1.9:33.3: uppādetuṃ na sakkā, mahā kho pana jambudīpo, gāmanigamarājadhāniyo
dhpak1.9:33.4: carantā addhā mokkhadhammadesakaṃ kañci ācariyaṃ labhissāmā ” ti.
dhpak1.9:34.1: Tato paṭṭhāya,“ yattha yattha paṇḍitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā atthī ” ti vadanti, tattha tattha gantvā sākacchaṃ karonti.
dhpak1.9:34.2: Tehi puṭṭhaṃ pañhaṃ aññe kathetuṃ na sakkonti,
dhpak1.9:34.3: te pana tesaṃ pañhaṃ vissajjenti. Evaṃ sakalajambudīpaṃ pariggaṇhitvā
dhpak1.9:34.4: nivattitvā sakaṭṭhānameva āgantvā,“ samma kolita, amhesu yo paṭhamaṃ
dhpak1.9:34.5: amataṃ adhigacchati, so itarassa ārocetū ” ti katikaṃ akaṃsuṃ.
dhpak1.9:35.1: Evaṃ tesu katikaṃ katvā viharantesu satthā vuttānukkamena rājagahaṃ patvā veḷuvanaṃ paṭiggahetvā veḷuvane viharati.
dhpak1.9:35.2: Tadā “ caratha, bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāyā ” ti ratanattayaguṇapakāsanatthaṃ uyyojitānaṃ ekasaṭṭhiyā arahantānaṃ
dhpak1.9:35.3: antare pañcavaggiyānaṃ abbhantaro assajitthero paṭinivattitvā rājagahaṃ
dhpak1.9:35.4: āgato, punadivase pātova pattacīvaramādāya rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
dhpak1.9:35.5: Tasmiṃ samaye upatissaparibbājakopi pātova bhattakiccaṃ katvā paribbājakārāmaṃ gacchanto theraṃ disvā cintesi –
dhpak1.9:35.6: “ mayā evarūpo pabbajito nāma na diṭṭhapubboyeva, ye loke
dhpak1.9:35.7: arahanto vā arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannā, ayaṃ tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aññataro,
dhpak1.9:35.8: yaṃnūnāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyaṃ – ‘ kaṃsi tvaṃ, āvuso, uddissa pabbajito, ko vā te satthā,
dhpak1.9:35.9: kassa vā tvaṃ dhammaṃ rocesī ”’ ti? Athassa etadahosi
dhpak1.9:35.10: – “ akālo kho imaṃ bhikkhuṃ pañhaṃ pucchituṃ, antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho
dhpak1.9:35.11: piṇḍāya carati, yaṃnūnāhaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandheyyaṃ, atthikehi upaññātaṃ maggan ” ti.
dhpak1.9:36.1: So theraṃ laddhapiṇḍapātaṃ aññataraṃ okāsaṃ gacchantaṃ
dhpak1.9:36.2: disvā nisīditukāmatañcassa ñatvā attano paribbājakapīṭhakaṃ paññāpetvā adāsi,
dhpak1.9:36.3: so bhattakiccapariyosānepissa attano kuṇḍikāya udakaṃ adāsi.
dhpak1.9:36.4: Evaṃ ācariyavattaṃ katvā katabhattakiccena therena saddhiṃ
dhpak1.9:36.5: madhurapaṭisanthāraṃ katvā evamāha – “ vippasannāni kho pana te, āvuso, indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto,
dhpak1.9:36.6: kaṃsi tvaṃ, āvuso, uddissa pabbajito, ko vā te satthā, kassa vā tvaṃ dhammaṃ rocesī ” ti pucchi.
dhpak1.9:37.2: sāsanassa paṭipakkhabhūtā, imassa sāsanassa gambhīrataṃ dassessāmī ” ti.
dhpak1.9:37.3: Attano navakabhāvaṃ dassento āha – “ ahaṃ kho, āvuso, navo acirapabbajito, adhunāgato imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ,
dhpak1.9:37.4: na tāvāhaṃ sakkhissāmi vitthārena dhammaṃ desetun ” ti. Paribbājako –
dhpak1.9:37.5: “ ahaṃ upatisso nāma, tvaṃ yathāsattiyā appaṃ vā bahuṃ vā vada,
dhpak1.9:37.6: etaṃ nayasatena nayasahassena paṭivijjhituṃ mayhaṃ bhāro ” ti cintetvā āha –
dhpak1.9:38.1: “ Appaṃ vā bahuṃ vā bhāsassu, atthaṃyeva me brūhi; Attheneva me attho, kiṃ kāhasi byañjanaṃ bahun ” ti.(mahāva.60);
dhpak1.9:40.1: Ye dhammā hetuppabhavā, tesaṃ hetuṃ tathāgato āha.
dhpak1.9:43.1: So sotāpanno hutvā uparivisese appavattante “ bhavissati ettha kāraṇan ” ti sallakkhetvā theraṃ āha – “ bhante,
dhpak1.9:43.2: mā upari dhammadesanaṃ vaḍḍhayittha, ettakameva hotu, kuhiṃ amhākaṃ satthā vasatī ” ti? “ Veḷuvane, āvuso ” ti. “ Tena hi,
dhpak1.9:43.3: bhante, tumhe purato yātha, mayhaṃ eko sahāyako atthi, amhehi
dhpak1.9:43.4: ca aññamaññaṃ katikā katā ‘ amhesu yo amataṃ paṭhamaṃ adhigacchati,
dhpak1.9:43.5: so itarassa ārocetū ’ ti. Ahaṃ taṃ paṭiññaṃ mocetvā sahāyakaṃ gahetvā tumhākaṃ gatamaggeneva satthu santikaṃ āgamissāmīti
dhpak1.9:43.6: pañcapatiṭṭhitena therassa pādesu nipatitvā tikkhattuṃ padakkhiṇaṃ
dhpak1.9:44.1: Atha kho kolitaparibbājako taṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ disvā,“ ajja mayhaṃ sahāyakassa mukhavaṇṇo na aññadivasesu viya,
dhpak1.9:44.2: addhā tena amataṃ adhigataṃ bhavissatī ” ti amatādhigamaṃ pucchi. Sopissa
dhpak1.9:44.3: “ āmāvuso, amataṃ adhigatan ” ti paṭijānitvā tameva gāthaṃ abhāsi.
dhpak1.9:44.4: Gāthāpariyosāne kolito sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhahitvā āha – “ kuhiṃ kira,
dhpak1.9:44.5: samma, amhākaṃ satthā vasatī ” ti? “ Veḷuvane kira,
dhpak1.9:44.6: samma, evaṃ no ācariyena assajittherena kathitan ” ti. “ Tena hi, samma, āyāma, satthāraṃ passissāmā ” ti.
dhpak1.9:45.1: Sāriputtatthero ca nāmesa sadāpi ācariyapūjakova, tasmā sahāyaṃ evamāha
dhpak1.9:45.2: – “ samma, amhehi adhigataṃ amataṃ amhākaṃ ācariyassa
dhpak1.9:45.5: buddhānaṃ desanaṃ sutvā maggaphalapaṭivedhaṃ karissatī ” ti. Tato dvepi janā sañcayassa santikaṃ agamaṃsu.
dhpak1.9:46.1: Sañcayo te disvāva – “ kiṃ, tātā, koci vo amatamaggadesako
dhpak1.9:46.2: laddho ” ti pucchi. “ Āma, ācariya, laddho, buddho loke uppanno,
dhpak1.9:46.3: dhammo loke uppanno, saṅgho loke uppanno, tumhe tucche asāre vicaratha, tasmā etha, satthu santikaṃ gamissāmā ” ti.
dhpak1.9:46.4: “ Gacchatha tumhe, nāhaṃ sakkhissāmī ” ti. “ Kiṃ kāraṇāhi ”? “ Ahaṃ mahājanassa ācariyo hutvā vicariṃ, vicarantassa me
dhpak1.9:46.5: antevāsikavāso cāṭiyā udañcanabhāvappatti viya hoti, na sakkhissāmahaṃ antevāsikavāsaṃ vasitun ” ti.
dhpak1.9:47.1: “ Mā evaṃ karittha, ācariyā ” ti. “ Hotu, tātā, gacchatha tumhe, nāhaṃ sakkhissāmī ” ti. Ācariya, loke buddhassa uppannakālato
dhpak1.9:47.2: paṭṭhāya mahājano gandhamālādihattho gantvā tameva pūjessati, mayampi tattheva gamissāma. “ Tumhe kiṃ karissathā ” ti?
dhpak1.9:47.3: “ Tātā, kiṃ nu kho imasmiṃ loke dandhā bahū, udāhu paṇḍitā ” ti. “ Dandhā, ācariya, bahū, paṇḍitā ca nāma katipayā eva hontī ” ti.
dhpak1.9:47.4: “ Tena hi, tātā, paṇḍitā paṇḍitassa samaṇassa gotamassa santikaṃ gamissanti, dandhā dandhassa mama santikaṃ āgamissanti,
dhpak1.9:47.5: gacchatha tumhe, nāhaṃ gamissāmī ” ti. Te “ paññāyissatha
dhpak1.9:47.6: tumhe, ācariyā ” ti pakkamiṃsu. Tesu gacchantesu sañcayassa parisā bhijji,
dhpak1.9:47.7: tasmiṃ khaṇe ārāmo tuccho ahosi. So tucchaṃ ārāmaṃ disvā uṇhaṃ lohitaṃ chaḍḍesi. Tehipi saddhiṃ gacchantesu pañcasu
dhpak1.9:47.8: paribbājakasatesu sañcayassa aḍḍhateyyasatāni nivattiṃsu, atha kho te attano antevāsikehi aḍḍhateyyehi paribbājakasatehi
dhpak1.9:48.1: Satthā catuparisamajjhe nisinno dhammaṃ desento te dūratova disvā bhikkhū āmantesi – “ ete, bhikkhave,
dhpak1.9:48.2: dve sahāyakā āgacchanti kolito ca upatisso ca, etaṃ me sāvakayugaṃ bhavissati aggaṃ bhaddayugan ” ti.
dhpak1.9:48.3: Te satthāraṃ vanditvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, nisīditvā ca pana bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ – “ labheyyāma mayaṃ, bhante,
dhpak1.9:48.4: bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadan ” ti. “ Etha,
dhpak1.9:48.5: bhikkhavo ” ti bhagavā avoca – “ svākkhāto dhammo,
dhpak1.9:48.7: ti. Sabbepi iddhimayapattacīvaradharā saṭṭhivassikattherā viya ahesuṃ.
dhpak1.9:49.1: Atha nesaṃ parisāya caritavasena satthā dhammadesanaṃ
dhpak1.9:49.2: vaḍḍhesi. Ṭhapetvā dve aggasāvake avasesā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu,
dhpak1.9:50.3: okkamante satthārā saṃvejito thinamiddhaṃ vinodetvā tathāgatena dinnaṃ dhātukammaṭṭhānaṃ suṇantova uparimaggattayakiccaṃ
dhpak1.9:51.3: viharanto attano bhāgineyyassa dīghanakhaparibbājakassa vedanāpariggahasuttante desiyamāne suttānusārena ñāṇaṃ pesetvā
dhpak1.9:51.4: parassa vaḍḍhitabhattaṃ paribhuñjanto viya sāvakapāramiñāṇassa matthakaṃ patto.
dhpak1.9:52.3: Yathā hi duggatamanussā yattha katthaci gantukāmā
dhpak1.9:52.4: khippameva nikkhamanti, rājūnaṃ pana hatthivāhanakappanādiṃ mahantaṃ
dhpak1.9:53.1: Taṃ divasaññeva pana satthā vaḍḍhamānakacchāyāya veḷuvane
dhpak1.9:53.2: sāvakasannipātaṃ katvā dvinnaṃ therānaṃ aggasāvakaṭṭhānaṃ datvā
dhpak1.9:53.4: mukholokanena bhikkhaṃ deti, aggasāvakaṭṭhānaṃ dadantena nāma paṭhamaṃ
dhpak1.9:53.7: ete anolokentena bhaddavaggiyānaṃ tiṃsajanānaṃ, ete anolokentena
dhpak1.9:53.8: uruvelakassapādīnaṃ tebhātikānaṃ, ete pana ettake mahāthere
dhpak1.9:53.9: pahāya sabbapacchā pabbajitānaṃ aggasāvakaṭṭhānaṃ dadantena mukhaṃ oloketvā dinnan ” ti.
dhpak1.9:54.1: Satthā,“ kiṃ kathetha, bhikkhave ” ti pucchitvā,“ idaṃ nāmā
dhpak1.9:54.2: ” ti vutte “ nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, mukhaṃ oloketvā bhikkhaṃ demi,
dhpak1.9:54.3: etesaṃ pana attanā attanā patthitapatthitameva demi. Aññātakoṇḍañño
dhpak1.9:54.4: hi ekasmiṃ sasse nava vāre aggasassadānaṃ dadanto
dhpak1.9:54.5: aggasāvakaṭṭhānaṃ patthetvā nādāsi, aggadhammaṃ pana arahattaṃ sabbapaṭhamaṃ paṭivijjhituṃ patthetvā adāsī ” ti.
dhpak1.9:54.6: “ Kadā pana bhagavā ” ti? “ Suṇissatha, bhikkhave ” ti. “ Āma, bhante ” ti, bhagavā atītaṃ āhari –
dhpak1.9:56.1: Bhikkhave, ito ekanavutikappe vipassī nāma bhagavā loke udapādi. Tadā mahākāḷo cūḷakāḷoti dvebhātikā kuṭumbikā mahantaṃ
dhpak1.9:56.2: sālikkhettaṃ vapāpesuṃ. Athekadivasaṃ cūḷakāḷo sālikkhettaṃ gantvā ekaṃ sāligabbhaṃ phāletvā khādi, taṃ atimadhuraṃ ahosi.
dhpak1.9:56.4: hutvā jeṭṭhabhātikaṃ upasaṅkamitvā,“ bhātika, sāligabbhaṃ phāletvā
dhpak1.9:56.5: buddhānaṃ anucchavikaṃ katvā pacāpetvā dānaṃ demā ” ti āha. “
dhpak1.9:56.6: Kiṃ vadesi, tāta, sāligabbhaṃ phāletvā dānaṃ nāma neva atīte bhūtapubbaṃ,
dhpak1.9:56.7: na anāgatepi bhavissati, mā sassaṃ nāsayī ” ti;
dhpak1.9:57.1: vuttopi so punappunaṃ yāciyeva. Atha naṃ bhātā,“ tena hi sālikkhettaṃ dve koṭṭhāse katvā mama koṭṭhāsaṃ anāmasitvā attano
dhpak1.9:57.2: koṭṭhāse khette yaṃ icchasi, taṃ karohī ” ti āha. So “ sādhū ” ti khettaṃ vibhajitvā bahū manusse hatthakammaṃ yācitvā
dhpak1.9:57.6: aggadānaṃ aggadhammassa sabbapaṭhamaṃ paṭivedhāya saṃvattatū ” ti āha.
dhpak1.9:58.1: So khettaṃ gantvā olokento sakalakkhettaṃ kaṇṇikabaddhehi
dhpak1.9:58.2: viya sālisīsehi sañchannaṃ disvā pañcavidhapītiṃ paṭilabhitvā,“
dhpak1.9:58.3: lābhā vata me ” ti cintetvā puthukakāle puthukaggaṃ
dhpak1.9:58.4: nāma adāsi, gāmavāsīhi saddhiṃ aggasassadānaṃ nāma adāsi, lāyane lāyanaggaṃ,
dhpak1.9:58.5: veṇikaraṇe veṇaggaṃ, kalāpādīsu kalāpaggaṃ, khalaggaṃ, khalabhaṇḍaggaṃ,
dhpak1.9:58.6: koṭṭhagganti. Evaṃ ekasasse nava vāre aggadānaṃ adāsi.
dhpak1.9:58.9: ahosi. Dhammo hi nāmesa attānaṃ rakkhantaṃ rakkhati.
dhpak1.9:60.1: “ Dhammo have rakkhati dhammacāriṃ, Dhammo suciṇṇo sukhamāvahāti; Esānisaṃso dhamme suciṇṇe, Na duggatiṃ gacchati dhammacārī ” ti.(theragā.303;
dhpak1.9:61.1: “ Evamesa vipassīsammāsambuddhakāle aggadhammaṃ paṭhamaṃ paṭivijjhituṃ patthento nava vāre aggadānāni adāsi.
dhpak1.9:61.2: Ito satasahassakappamatthake pana haṃsavatīnagare padumuttarasambuddhakālepi sattāhaṃ mahādānaṃ datvā tassa bhagavato
dhpak1.9:61.3: pādamūle nipajjitvā aggadhammassa paṭhamaṃ paṭivijjhanatthameva patthanaṃ
dhpak1.9:61.4: ṭhapesi. Iti iminā patthitameva mayā dinnaṃ,
dhpak1.9:61.5: nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, mukhaṃ oloketvā demī ” ti.
dhpak1.9:62.1: “ Yasakulaputtappamukhā pañcapaññāsa janā kiṃ kammaṃ kariṃsu, bhante ” ti? “ Etepi ekassa buddhassa santike arahattaṃ
dhpak1.9:64.1: aparabhāge anuppanne buddhe sahāyakā hutvā vaggabandhanena puññāni karontā anāthamatasarīrāni paṭijaggantā vicariṃsu.
dhpak1.9:64.2: Te ekadivasaṃ sagabbhaṃ itthiṃ kālakataṃ disvā,‘ jhāpessāmā ’ ti
dhpak1.9:64.3: susānaṃ hariṃsu. Tesu pañca jane ‘ tumhe jhāpethā ’ ti
dhpak1.9:65.1: Yasadārako taṃ matasarīraṃ sūlehi vijjhitvā parivattetvā parivattetvā
dhpak1.9:65.2: jhāpento asubhasaññaṃ paṭilabhi, itaresampi catunnaṃ janānaṃ –
dhpak1.9:65.3: ‘ passatha, bho, imaṃ sarīraṃ tattha tattha viddhaṃsitacammaṃ, kabaragorūpaṃ viya asuciṃ duggandhaṃ paṭikūlan ’ ti dassesi.
dhpak1.9:66.1: Tepi tattha asubhasaññaṃ paṭilabhiṃsu. Te pañcapi janā
dhpak1.9:66.2: gāmaṃ gantvā sesasahāyakānaṃ kathayiṃsu. Yaso pana dārako gehaṃ
dhpak1.9:66.3: gantvā mātāpitūnañca bhariyāya ca kathesi. Te sabbepi asubhaṃ bhāvayiṃsu.
dhpak1.9:67.1: Idametesaṃ pubbakammaṃ. Teneva yasassa itthāgāre susānasaññā
dhpak1.9:67.2: uppajji, tāya ca upanissayasampattiyā sabbesampi visesādhigamo nibbatti.
dhpak1.9:70.1: “ Etepi pubbabuddhānaṃ santike arahattaṃ patthetvā puññāni katvā aparabhāge anuppanne buddhe tiṃsa dhuttā hutvā tuṇḍilovādaṃ
dhpak1.9:71.1: Evaṃ imepi attanā patthitameva labhiṃsu. Nāhaṃ mukhaṃ oloketvā dammī ” ti.
dhpak1.9:72.1: “ Uruvelakassapādayo pana kiṃ kammaṃ kariṃsu, bhante
dhpak1.9:72.2: ” ti? “ Tepi arahattameva patthetvā puññāni kariṃsu.
dhpak1.9:74.1: Ito hi dvenavutikappe tisso phussoti dve buddhā uppajjiṃsu. Phussabuddhassa mahindo nāma rājā pitā ahosi.
dhpak1.9:74.2: Tasmiṃ pana sambodhiṃ patte rañño kaniṭṭhaputto paṭhamaaggasāvako purohitaputto dutiyaaggasāvako ahosi.
dhpak1.9:74.4: me buddho, kaniṭṭhaputto paṭhamaaggasāvako, purohitaputto dutiyaaggasāvako ’
dhpak1.9:74.5: ti te oloketvā,‘ mameva buddho, mameva dhammo, mameva
dhpak1.9:74.6: saṅgho, namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassā ’ ti tikkhattuṃ
dhpak1.9:74.7: udānaṃ udānetvā satthu pādamūle nipajjitvā,‘ bhante, idāni me navutivassasahassaparimāṇassa āyuno koṭiyaṃ nisīditvā
dhpak1.9:74.8: niddāyanakālo viya aññesaṃ gehadvāraṃ agantvā yāvāhaṃ jīvāmi, tāva
dhpak1.9:74.9: me cattāro paccaye adhivāsethā ’ ti paṭiññaṃ gahetvā
dhpak1.9:75.1: Rañño pana aparepi tato puttā ahesuṃ. Tesu jeṭṭhassa pañca yodhasatāni parivārāni, majjhimassa tīṇi, kaniṭṭhassa dve.
dhpak1.9:75.2: Te ‘ mayampi bhātikaṃ bhojessāmā ’ ti pitaraṃ okāsaṃ yācitvā alabhamānā punappunaṃ yācantāpi alabhitvā paccante kupite
dhpak1.9:75.3: tassa vūpasamanatthāya pesitā paccantaṃ vūpasametvā pitu santikaṃ āgamiṃsu.
dhpak1.9:76.1: Atha ne pitā āliṅgitvā sīse cumbitvā,‘ varaṃ vo, tātā, dammī ’ ti āha. “ Te ‘ sādhu devā ’ ti varaṃ gahitakaṃ katvā puna
dhpak1.9:76.2: katipāhaccayena pitarā ‘ gaṇhatha, tātā, varan ’ ti vuttā,“ deva, amhākaṃ aññena kenaci attho natthi, ito paṭṭhāya mayaṃ
dhpak1.9:76.3: bhātikaṃ bhojessāma, imaṃ no varaṃ dehī ” ti āhaṃsu. ‘
dhpak1.9:76.4: Na demi, tātā ’ ti. ‘ Niccakālaṃ adento satta saṃvaccharāni detha,
dhpak1.9:76.5: devā ’ ti. ‘ Na demi, tātā ’ ti. ‘ Tena hi cha pañca
dhpak1.9:76.6: cattāri tīṇi dve ekaṃ saṃvaccharaṃ detha, devā ’ ti. ‘ Na demi, tātā ’ ti.
dhpak1.9:76.7: ‘ Tena hi, deva, satta māse dethā ’ ti. ‘ Cha māse pañca māse
dhpak1.9:76.8: cattāro māse tayo māse detha, devā ’ ti. ‘ Na demi, tātā ’ ti.
dhpak1.9:76.9: ‘ Hotu, deva, ekekassa no ekekaṃ māsaṃ katvā tayo māse dethā ’ ti. ‘ Sādhu, tātā, tena hi tayo māse bhojethā ’ ti āha.
dhpak1.9:76.10: Te tuṭṭhā rājānaṃ vanditvā sakaṭṭhānameva gatā.
dhpak1.9:77.1: Tesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi ekova koṭṭhāgāriko, ekova āyuttako, tassa dvādasanahutā purisaparivārā. Te te pakkosāpetvā,‘ mayaṃ
dhpak1.9:77.2: imaṃ temāsaṃ dasa sīlāni gahetvā dve kāsāvāni nivāsetvā
dhpak1.9:77.3: satthārā sahavāsaṃ vasissāma, tumhe ettakaṃ nāma dānavattaṃ gahetvā
dhpak1.9:77.5: sabbaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ pavatteyyātha. Mayañhi ito paṭṭhāya
dhpak1.9:77.6: na kiñci vakkhāmā ’ ti vadiṃsu. “ Te tayopi
dhpak1.9:77.7: janā parivārasahassaṃ gahetvā dasa sīlāni samādāya kāsāyavatthāni nivāsetvā vihāreyeva vasiṃsu.
dhpak1.9:78.1: Koṭṭhāgāriko ca āyuttako ca ekato hutvā tiṇṇaṃ
dhpak1.9:78.2: bhātikānaṃ koṭṭhāgārehi vārena vārena dānavattaṃ gahetvā dānaṃ denti,
dhpak1.9:78.3: kammakārānaṃ pana puttā yāgubhattādīnaṃ atthāya rodanti. Te tesaṃ bhikkhusaṅghe anāgateyeva yāgubhattādīni denti.
dhpak1.9:78.4: Bhikkhusaṅghassa bhattakiccāvasāne kiñci atirekaṃ na bhūtapubbaṃ. Te ‘
dhpak1.9:78.5: aparabhāge dārakānaṃ demā ’ ti attanāpi gahetvā khādiṃsu.
dhpak1.9:78.6: Manuññaṃ āhāraṃ disvā adhivāsetuṃ nāsakkhiṃsu. Te
dhpak1.9:78.7: pana caturāsītisahassā ahesuṃ. Te saṅghassa dinnadānavattaṃ khāditvā
dhpak1.9:78.8: kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā pettivisaye nibbattiṃsu.
dhpak1.9:79.1: Tebhātikā pana purisasahassena saddhiṃ kālaṃ katvā devaloke nibbattitvā devalokā manussalokaṃ, manussalokā devalokaṃ
dhpak1.9:80.1: ‘ Evaṃ te tayo bhātaro arahattaṃ patthentā
dhpak1.9:81.1: Tadā pana tesaṃ āyuttako bimbisāro rājā ahosi, koṭṭhāgāriko visākho upāsako. Tayo rājakumārā tayo jaṭilā ahesuṃ.
dhpak1.9:81.2: Tesaṃ kammakārā tadā petesu nibbattitvā sugatiduggativasena saṃsarantā imasmiṃ kappe cattāri buddhantarāni petalokeyeva nibbattiṃsu.
dhpak1.9:81.3: Te imasmiṃ kappe sabbapaṭhamaṃ uppannaṃ cattālīsavassasahassāyukaṃ kakusandhaṃ bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā,“ amhākaṃ āhāraṃ
dhpak1.9:81.4: labhanakālaṃ ācikkhathā ” ti pucchiṃsu. So “ mama tāva kāle na labhissatha, mama pacchato mahāpathaviyā yojanamattaṃ
dhpak1.9:81.5: abhiruḷhāya koṇāgamano nāma buddho uppajjissati, taṃ puccheyyāthā ” ti
dhpak1.9:81.6: āha. Te tattakaṃ kālaṃ khepetvā tasmiṃ uppanne taṃ pucchiṃsu.
dhpak1.9:81.7: Sopi “ mama kāle na labhissatha, mama pacchato mahāpathaviyā yojanamattaṃ abhiruḷhāya kassapo nāma buddho uppajjissati,
dhpak1.9:81.8: taṃ puccheyyāthā ” ti āha. Te tattakaṃ kālaṃ khepetvā tasmiṃ uppanne taṃ pucchiṃsu. Sopi “ mama kāle na labhissatha,
dhpak1.9:81.9: mama pana pacchato mahāpathaviyā yojanamattaṃ abhiruḷhāya gotamo nāma buddho uppajjissati, tadā tumhākaṃ ñātako bimbisāro
dhpak1.9:81.10: nāma rājā bhavissati, so satthu dānaṃ datvā tumhākaṃ pattiṃ pāpessati, tadā labhissathā ” ti āha.
dhpak1.9:83.1: Satthā,“ mahārāja, ito dvenavutikappamatthake phussabuddhakāle ete tava ñātakā, bhikkhusaṅghassa dinnadānavattaṃ khāditvā
dhpak1.9:83.2: petaloke nibbattitvā saṃsarantā kakusandhādayo buddhe pucchitvā tehi idañcidañca vuttā ettakaṃ kālaṃ tava dānaṃ paccāsīsamānā
dhpak1.9:83.3: hiyyo tayā dāne dinne pattiṃ alabhamānā evamakaṃsū ” ti āha. “ Kiṃ pana, bhante, idānipi dinne labhissantī ” ti? “ Āma,
dhpak1.9:83.4: mahārājā ” ti. Rājā buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ nimantetvā punadivase mahādānaṃ datvā,“ bhante, ito tesaṃ petānaṃ
dhpak1.9:83.5: dibbaannapānaṃ sampajjatū ” ti pattiṃ adāsi, tesaṃ tatheva nibbatti.
dhpak1.9:84.1: Punadivase naggā hutvā attānaṃ dassesuṃ. Rājā “ ajja, bhante, naggā hutvā attānaṃ dassesun ” ti ārocesi.
dhpak1.9:84.2: “ Vatthāni te na dinnāni, mahārājā ” ti. Rājāpi punadivase buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṅghassa cīvaradānaṃ datvā,“ ito
dhpak1.9:84.3: tesaṃ petānaṃ dibbavatthāni hontū ” ti pāpesi.
dhpak1.9:84.4: Taṅkhaṇaññeva tesaṃ dibbavatthāni uppajjiṃsu. Te petattabhāvaṃ vijahitvā
dhpak1.9:86.1: Tirokuṭṭesu tiṭṭhanti, sandhisiṅghāṭakesu ca; Dvārabāhāsu tiṭṭhanti, āgantvāna sakaṃ gharaṃ.
dhpak1.9:87.1: Pahūte annapānamhi, khajjabhojje upaṭṭhite; Na tesaṃ koci sarati, sattānaṃ kammapaccayā.
dhpak1.9:88.1: Evaṃ dadanti ñātīnaṃ, ye honti anukampakā; Suciṃ paṇītaṃ kālena, kappiyaṃ pānabhojanaṃ;
dhpak1.9:89.1: Idaṃ vo ñātīnaṃ hotu, sukhitā hontu
dhpak1.9:89.2: ñātayo. Te ca tattha samāgantvā, ñātipetā samāgatā;
dhpak1.9:90.1: Pahūte annapānamhi, sakkaccaṃ anumodare. Ciraṃ jīvantu no ñātī, yesaṃ hetu labhāmase;
dhpak1.9:91.1: Amhākañca katā pūjā, dāyakā ca anipphalā. Na hi tattha kasi atthi, gorakkhettha na vijjati;
dhpak1.9:92.1: Vaṇijjā tādisī natthi, hiraññena kayākayaṃ; Ito dinnena yāpenti, petā kālagatā tahiṃ.
dhpak1.9:93.1: Unname udakaṃ vuṭṭhaṃ, yathā ninnaṃ pavattati; Evameva ito dinnaṃ, petānaṃ upakappati.
dhpak1.9:94.1: Yathā vārivahā pūrā, paripūrenti sāgaraṃ; Evameva ito dinnaṃ, petānaṃ upakappati.
dhpak1.9:95.1: Adāsi me akāsi me, ñāti mittā sakhā ca me; Petānaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ dajjā, pubbe katamanussaraṃ.
dhpak1.9:96.1: Na hi ruṇṇaṃ vā soko vā, yā caññā paridevanā; Na taṃ petānamatthāya, evaṃ tiṭṭhanti ñātayo.
dhpak1.9:97.1: Ayañca kho dakkhiṇā dinnā, saṅghamhi suppatiṭṭhitā; Dīgharattaṃ hitāyassa, ṭhānaso upakappati.
dhpak1.9:98.1: So ñātidhammo ca ayaṃ nidassito, petāna pūjā ca
dhpak1.9:98.2: katā uḷārā; Balañca bhikkhūnamanuppadinnaṃ, tumhehi puññaṃ pasutaṃ anappaka.
dhpak1.9:99.1: Anumodanāvasāne caturāsītiyā pāṇasahassānaṃ dhammābhisamayo ahosi. Iti satthā tebhātikajaṭilānaṃ vatthuṃ kathetvā imampi
dhpak1.9:102.1: Ito kappasatasahassādhikassa hi kappānaṃ asaṅkhyeyyassa matthake
dhpak1.9:102.2: sāriputto brāhmaṇamahāsālakule nibbatti, nāmena saradamāṇavo nāma ahosi.
dhpak1.9:102.3: Moggallāno gahapatimahāsālakule nibbatti, nāmena sirivaḍḍhanakuṭumbiko nāma ahosi. Te ubhopi sahapaṃsukīḷakā sahāyakā ahesuṃ.
dhpak1.9:103.1: Tesu saradamāṇavo pitu accayena kusalantakaṃ mahādhanaṃ paṭipajjitvā
dhpak1.9:103.2: ekadivasaṃ rahogato cintesi – “ ahaṃ idhalokattabhāvameva jānāmi,
dhpak1.9:103.3: no paralokattabhāvaṃ. Jātasattānañca maraṇaṃ nāma dhuvaṃ, mayā ekaṃ pabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā mokkhadhammagavesanaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatī ” ti.
dhpak1.9:103.4: So sahāyakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā āha – “ samma sirivaḍḍhana, ahaṃ pabbajitvā mokkhadhammaṃ gavesissāmi, tvaṃ mayā saddhiṃ
dhpak1.9:103.5: pabbajituṃ sakkhissasi, na sakkhissasī ” ti? “ Na sakkhissāmi, samma, tvaṃyeva pabbajāhī ” ti. So cintesi –
dhpak1.9:103.6: “ paralokaṃ gacchanto sahāye vā ñātimitte vā gahetvā gato nāma natthi, attanā kataṃ attanova hotī ” ti.
dhpak1.9:104.3: Tassa eko dve tayoti evaṃ anupabbajjaṃ
dhpak1.9:104.4: pabbajitā catusattatisahassamattā jaṭilā ahesuṃ. So pañca abhiññā,
dhpak1.9:104.5: aṭṭha ca samāpattiyo nibbattetvā tesaṃ jaṭilānaṃ kasiṇaparikammaṃ ācikkhi.
dhpak1.9:104.6: Tepi sabbe pañca abhiññā aṭṭha ca samāpattiyo nibbattesuṃ.
dhpak1.9:105.1: Tena samayena anomadassī nāma sammāsambuddho loke udapādi. Nagaraṃ candavatī nāma ahosi, pitā yasavā nāma khattiyo,
dhpak1.9:105.2: mātā yasodharā nāma devī, bodhi ajjunarukkho, nisabho ca anomo ca dve aggasāvakā, varuṇo nāma upaṭṭhāko,
dhpak1.9:105.3: sundarā ca sumanā ca dve aggasāvikā ahesuṃ. Āyu vassasatasahassaṃ ahosi, sarīraṃ aṭṭhapaññāsahatthubbedhaṃ,
dhpak1.9:106.1: So ekadivasaṃ paccūsakāle mahākaruṇāsamāpattito vuṭṭhāya lokaṃ volokento saradatāpasaṃ disvā,“ ajja mayhaṃ saradatāpasassaṃ
dhpak1.9:106.2: santikaṃ gatapaccayena dhammadesanā ca mahatī bhavissati, so ca aggasāvakaṭṭhānaṃ patthessati, tassa sahāyako
dhpak1.9:107.1: attano pattacīvaramādāya aññaṃ kañci anāmantetvā sīho viya ekacaro hutvā saradatāpasassa antevāsikesu phalāphalatthāya
dhpak1.9:107.3: adhiṭṭhahitvā passantasseva saradatāpasassa ākāsato otaritvā pathaviyaṃ patiṭṭhāsi.
dhpak1.9:108.1: Saradatāpaso buddhānubhāvañceva sarīranipphattiñcassa disvā lakkhaṇamante sammasitvā “ imehi lakkhaṇehi samannāgato nāma
dhpak1.9:108.2: agāramajjhe vasanto rājā hoti cakkavattī, pabbajanto loke
dhpak1.9:108.3: vivaṭṭacchado sabbaññubuddho hoti. Ayaṃ puriso nissaṃsayaṃ buddho
dhpak1.9:109.2: paññāpetvā adāsi. Nisīdi bhagavā paññatte aggāsane.
dhpak1.9:109.3: Saradatāpasopi attano anucchavikaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dhpak1.9:110.1: Tasmiṃ samaye catusattatisahassajaṭilā paṇītapaṇītāni ojavantāni phalāphalāni gahetvā ācariyassa santikaṃ sampattā
dhpak1.9:110.2: buddhānañceva ācariyassa ca nisinnāsanaṃ oloketvā āhaṃsu – “ ācariya,
dhpak1.9:110.3: mayaṃ ‘ imasmiṃ loke tumhehi mahantataro natthī ’ ti vicarāma,
dhpak1.9:110.4: ayaṃ pana puriso tumhehi mahantataro maññe ” ti? “ Tātā, kiṃ vadetha, sāsapena saddhiṃ aṭṭhasaṭṭhiyojanasatasahassubbedhaṃ
dhpak1.9:110.5: sineruṃ samaṃ kātuṃ icchatha, sabbaññubuddhena saddhiṃ mamaṃ upamaṃ mā karittha puttakā ” ti. Atha te tāpasā,“ sacāyaṃ
dhpak1.9:110.6: ittarasatto abhavissa, amhākaṃ ācariyo na evarūpaṃ upamaṃ āharissa, yāva
dhpak1.9:110.7: mahā vatāyaṃ puriso ” ti sabbeva pādesu nipatitvā sirasā vandiṃsu.
dhpak1.9:111.1: Atha ne ācariyo āha – “ tātā, amhākaṃ buddhānaṃ anucchaviko deyyadhammo natthi, satthā ca bhikkhācāravelāyaṃ idhāgato,
dhpak1.9:111.2: mayaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ deyyadhammaṃ dassāma, tumhe yaṃ yaṃ paṇītaṃ phalāphalaṃ, taṃ taṃ āharathā ” ti āharāpetvā
dhpak1.9:111.3: hatthe dhovitvā sayaṃ tathāgatassa patte patiṭṭhāpesi.
dhpak1.9:111.4: Satthārā phalāphale paṭiggahitamatte devatā dibbojaṃ pakkhipiṃsu.
dhpak1.9:111.5: So tāpaso udakampi sayameva parissāvetvā adāsi. Tato
dhpak1.9:111.6: bhattakiccaṃ katvā nisinne satthari sabbe antevāsike pakkositvā satthu
dhpak1.9:112.1: Satthā “ dve aggasāvakā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ āgacchantū ” ti cintesi. Te satthu cittaṃ ñatvā satasahassakhīṇāsavaparivārā
dhpak1.9:112.2: āgantvā satthāraṃ vanditvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Tato saradatāpaso
dhpak1.9:112.3: antevāsike āmantesi – “ tātā, buddhānaṃ nisinnāsanampi nīcaṃ,
dhpak1.9:112.4: samaṇasatasahassānampi āsanaṃ natthi, ajja tumhehi uḷāraṃ buddhasakkāraṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati, pabbatapādato vaṇṇagandhasampannāni
dhpak1.9:113.1: Kathanakālo papañco viya hoti, iddhimato pana
dhpak1.9:113.2: iddhivisayo acinteyyoti muhuttamatteneva te tāpasā vaṇṇagandhasampannāni
dhpak1.9:113.4: paññāpesuṃ. Ubhinnaṃ aggasāvakānaṃ tigāvutaṃ, sesabhikkhūnaṃ aḍḍhayojanikādibhedaṃ,
dhpak1.9:113.5: saṅghanavakassa usabhamattaṃ ahosi. “ Kathaṃ ekasmiṃ assamapade
dhpak1.9:113.6: tāva mahantāni āsanāni paññattānī ” ti na cintetabbaṃ.
dhpak1.9:113.7: Iddhivisayo hesa. Evaṃ paññattesu āsanesu saradatāpaso
dhpak1.9:113.8: tathāgatassa purato añjaliṃ paggayha ṭhito,“ bhante,
dhpak1.9:113.9: mayhaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya imaṃ pupphāsanaṃ abhiruhathā ” ti āha. Tena vuttaṃ –
dhpak1.9:114.1: “ Nānāpupphañca gandhañca, sampādetvāna ekato; Pupphāsanaṃ paññāpetvā, idaṃ vacanamabravi.
dhpak1.9:115.1: “ Idaṃ me āsanaṃ vīra, paññattaṃ tavanucchaviṃ; Mama cittaṃ pasādento, nisīda pupphamāsane.
dhpak1.9:116.1: “ Sattarattindivaṃ buddho, nisīdi pupphamāsane; Mama cittaṃ pasādetvā, hāsayitvā sadevake ” ti.
dhpak1.9:117.1: Evaṃ nisinne satthari dve aggasāvakā sesabhikkhū ca
dhpak1.9:117.2: attano attano pattāsane nisīdiṃsu. Saradatāpaso mahantaṃ pupphacchattaṃ
dhpak1.9:117.3: gahetvā tathāgatassa matthake dhārento aṭṭhāsi. Satthā “ jaṭilānaṃ
dhpak1.9:117.4: ayaṃ sakkāro mahapphalo hotū ” ti nirodhasamāpattiṃ samāpajji.
dhpak1.9:117.5: Satthu samāpattiṃ samāpannabhāvaṃ ñatvā dve aggasāvakāpi sesabhikkhūpi samāpattiṃ samāpajjiṃsu.
dhpak1.9:118.1: Tathāgate sattāhaṃ nirodhasamāpattiṃ samāpajjitvā nisinne antevāsikā bhikkhācārakāle sampatte vanamūlaphalāphalaṃ
dhpak1.9:118.3: tiṭṭhanti. Saradatāpaso pana bhikkhācārampi agantvā pupphacchattaṃ
dhpak1.9:119.1: Satthā nirodhato vuṭṭhāya dakkhiṇapasse nisinnaṃ paṭhamaaggasāvakaṃ
dhpak1.9:119.3: tāpasānaṃ pupphāsanānumodanaṃ karohī ” ti. Thero cakkavattirañño santikā paṭiladdhamahālābho mahāyodho viya tuṭṭhamānaso
dhpak1.9:119.4: sāvakapāramiñāṇe ṭhatvā pupphāsanānumodanaṃ ārabhi. Tassa desanāvasāne dutiyasāvakaṃ āmantesi
dhpak1.9:119.6: Anomatthero tepiṭakaṃ buddhavacanaṃ sammasitvā dhammaṃ kathesi.
dhpak1.9:119.7: Dvinnaṃ aggasāvakānaṃ desanāya ekassāpi abhisamayo nāhosi.
dhpak1.9:120.1: Atha satthā aparimāṇe buddhavisaye ṭhatvā dhammadesanaṃ ārabhi. Desanāpariyosāne ṭhapetvā saradatāpasaṃ sabbepi
dhpak1.9:120.2: catusattatisahassajaṭilā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu, satthā “ etha, bhikkhavo
dhpak1.9:120.3: ” ti hatthaṃ pasāresi. Tesaṃ tāvadeva kesamassūni
dhpak1.9:121.2: ti? Vikkhittacittattā. So kira buddhānaṃ dutiyāsane nisīditvā sāvakapāramiñāṇe
dhpak1.9:121.3: ṭhatvā dhammaṃ desayato aggasāvakassa dhammadesanaṃ sotuṃ
dhpak1.9:121.4: āraddhakālato paṭṭhāya,“ aho vatāhampi anāgate uppajjanakabuddhassa
dhpak1.9:121.5: sāsane iminā sāvakena paṭiladdhadhuraṃ labheyyan ” ti
dhpak1.9:121.6: cittaṃ uppādesi. So tena parivitakkena maggaphalapaṭivedhaṃ kātuṃ nāsakkhi.
dhpak1.9:122.1: Tathāgataṃ pana vanditvā sammukhe ṭhatvā āha – “ bhante, tumhākaṃ
dhpak1.9:122.2: anantarāsane nisinno bhikkhu tumhākaṃ sāsane ko nāma hotī ” ti?
dhpak1.9:122.4: koṭippatto soḷasa paññā paṭivijjhitvā ṭhito mayhaṃ sāsane
dhpak1.9:122.5: aggasāvako nisabho nāma eso ” ti. “ Bhante, yvāyaṃ mayā sattāhaṃ pupphacchattaṃ dhārentena sakkāro kato,
dhpak1.9:122.6: ahaṃ imassa phalena aññaṃ sakkattaṃ vā brahmattaṃ vā
dhpak1.9:122.7: na patthemi, anāgate pana ayaṃ nisabhatthero viya ekassa buddhassa
dhpak1.9:123.1: Satthā “ samajjhissati nu kho imassa purisassa
dhpak1.9:123.2: patthanā ” ti anāgataṃsañāṇaṃ pesetvā olokento kappasatasahassādhikaṃ ekaṃ
dhpak1.9:123.3: asaṅkhyeyyaṃ atikkamitvā samijjhanabhāvaṃ addasa. Disvāna saradatāpasaṃ āha
dhpak1.9:123.4: – “ na te ayaṃ patthanā moghā bhavissati,
dhpak1.9:123.5: anāgate pana kappasatasahassādhikaṃ ekaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ atikkamitvā
dhpak1.9:123.6: gotamo nāma buddho uppajjissati, tassa mātā mahāmāyā
dhpak1.9:123.7: nāma devī bhavissati, pitā suddhodano nāma mahārājā, putto
dhpak1.9:123.8: rāhulo nāma, upaṭṭhāko ānando nāma, dutiyaaggasāvako moggallāno nāma,
dhpak1.9:123.9: tvaṃ panassa paṭhamaaggasāvako dhammasenāpati sāriputto nāma bhavissasī ” ti.
dhpak1.9:124.3: santikaṃ gantvā sahāyakassa sirivaḍḍhanakuṭumbikassa sāsanaṃ pesesi,“ bhante, mama sahāyakassa vadetha,
dhpak1.9:124.5: anāgate uppajjanakassa gotamabuddhassa sāsane paṭhamaaggasāvakaṭṭhānaṃ patthitaṃ,
dhpak1.9:124.6: tvaṃ dutiyaaggasāvakaṭṭhānaṃ patthehī ” ti. Evañca pana
dhpak1.9:124.7: vatvā therehi puretarameva ekapassena gantvā sirivaḍḍhanassa nivesanadvāre aṭṭhāsi.
dhpak1.9:125.1: Sirivaḍḍhano “ cirassaṃ vata me ayyo āgato ”
dhpak1.9:125.2: ti āsane nisīdāpetvā attanā nīcāsane nisinno,“ antevāsikaparisā pana vo,
dhpak1.9:125.3: bhante, na paññāyatī ” ti pucchi. “ Āma, samma, amhākaṃ
dhpak1.9:125.4: assamaṃ anomadassī buddho āgato, mayaṃ tassa attano balena sakkāraṃ akarimhā,
dhpak1.9:125.5: satthā sabbesaṃ dhammaṃ desesi, desanāpariyosāne ṭhapetvā maṃ
dhpak1.9:125.6: sesā arahattaṃ patvā pabbajiṃsu. Ahaṃ satthu paṭhamaaggasāvakaṃ
dhpak1.9:125.7: nisabhattheraṃ disvā anāgate uppajjanakassa gotamabuddhassa nāma sāsane paṭhamaaggasāvakaṭṭhānaṃ patthesiṃ,
dhpak1.9:125.8: tvampi tassa sāsane dutiyaaggasāvakaṭṭhānaṃ patthehī ” ti. “ Mayhaṃ buddhehi saddhiṃ paricayo natthi, bhante ” ti.
dhpak1.9:125.9: “ Buddhehi saddhiṃ kathanaṃ mayhaṃ bhāro hotu, tvaṃ mahantaṃ sakkāraṃ sajjehī ” ti.
dhpak1.9:126.1: Sirivaḍḍhano tassa vacanaṃ sutvā attano nivesanadvāre rājamānena aṭṭhakarīsamattaṃ ṭhānaṃ samatalaṃ kāretvā vālukaṃ
dhpak1.9:126.2: okirāpetvā lājapañcamānipupphāni vikirāpetvā nīluppalacchadanaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kāretvā buddhāsanaṃ paññāpetvā sesabhikkhūnampi
dhpak1.9:126.3: āsanāni paṭiyādetvā mahantaṃ sakkārasammānaṃ sajjetvā buddhānaṃ nimantanatthāya saradatāpasassa saññaṃ adāsi.
dhpak1.9:126.4: Tāpaso buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ gahetvā tassa nivesanaṃ agamāsi. Sirivaḍḍhanopi paccuggamanaṃ katvā tathāgatassa
dhpak1.9:126.5: hatthato pattaṃ gahetvā maṇḍapaṃ pavesetvā paññattāsanesu nisinnassa buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṅghassa dakkhiṇodakaṃ
dhpak1.9:126.7: buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ mahārahehi vatthehi acchādetvā,“ bhante,
dhpak1.9:126.8: nāyaṃ ārabbho appamattakaṭṭhānatthāya, imināva niyāmena sattāhaṃ anukampaṃ karothā ” ti āha.
dhpak1.9:127.1: Satthā adhivāsesi. So teneva niyāmena sattāhaṃ mahādānaṃ
dhpak1.9:127.2: pavattetvā bhagavantaṃ vanditvā añjaliṃ paggayha ṭhito āha –
dhpak1.9:127.5: bhaveyyan ” ti patthesi, ahampi “ tasseva dutiyaaggasāvako
dhpak1.9:128.1: Satthā anāgataṃ oloketvā tassa patthanāya samijjhanabhāvaṃ disvā byākāsi – “ tvaṃ ito kappasatasahassādhikaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ
dhpak1.9:128.3: Buddhānaṃ byākaraṇaṃ sutvā sirivaḍḍhano haṭṭhapahaṭṭho ahosi.
dhpak1.9:128.4: Satthāpi bhattānumodanaṃ katvā saparivāro vihārameva gato.
dhpak1.9:129.1: “ Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, mama puttehi tadā patthitapatthanā. Te
dhpak1.9:130.1: Evaṃ vutte dve aggasāvakā bhagavantaṃ vanditvā,“ bhante, mayaṃ agāriyabhūtā samānā giraggasamajjaṃ dassanāya gatā ” ti
dhpak1.9:130.2: yāva assajittherassa santikā sotāpattiphalapaṭivedhā sabbaṃ paccuppannavatthuṃ kathetvā,“ te mayaṃ, bhante,
dhpak1.9:130.3: ācariyassa sañcayassa santikaṃ gantvā taṃ tumhākaṃ pādamūle
dhpak1.9:130.4: ānetukāmā tassa laddhiyā nissārabhāvaṃ kathetvā idhāgamane ānisaṃsaṃ kathayimhā.
dhpak1.9:130.5: So idāni mayhaṃ antevāsikavāso nāma cāṭiyā udañcanabhāvappattisadiso,
dhpak1.9:130.6: na sakkhissāmi antevāsivāsaṃ vasitun ” ti vatvā,“ ācariya,
dhpak1.9:130.7: idāni mahājano gandhamālādihattho gantvā satthārameva pūjessati, tumhe kathaṃ bhavissathā ” ti vutte “ kiṃ pana imasmiṃ
dhpak1.9:130.8: loke paṇḍitā bahū, udāhu dandhā ” ti? “ Dandhā ”
dhpak1.9:130.9: ti kathite “ tena hi paṇḍitā paṇḍitassa samaṇassa gotamassa santikaṃ gamissanti,
dhpak1.9:130.10: dandhā dandhassa mama santikaṃ āgamissanti, gacchatha tumhe ” ti vatvā “ āgantuṃ na icchi, bhante ” ti.
dhpak1.9:131.1: Taṃ sutvā satthā,“ bhikkhave, sañcayo attano
dhpak1.9:131.2: micchādiṭṭhitāya asāraṃ sāroti, sārañca asāroti gaṇhi.
dhpak1.9:131.3: Tumhe pana attano paṇḍitatāya sārañca sārato, asārañca asārato ñatvā asāraṃ
dhpak1.9:131.4: pahāya sārameva gaṇhitthā ” ti vatvā imā gāthā abhāsi –
dhpak1.9:132.1: 11. “ Asāre sāramatino, sāre cāsāradassino; Te sāraṃ nādhigacchanti, micchāsaṅkappagocarā.
dhpak1.9:134.1: 12. “ Sārañca sārato ñatvā, asārañca asārato; Te sāraṃ adhigacchanti, sammāsaṅkappagocarā ” ti.
dhpak1.9:135.2: asārato; Te sāraṃ adhigacchanti, sammāsaṅkappagocarā ” ti.
